items.title: 1.9 Ghar ke network ka setup aur configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of home network setup (PDF 16-17).

blocks.text: Ghar ka network ghar ke mukhtalif devices ko jorta hai, taake computers, mobile phones aur printers aapas mein baat kar sakein aur aik hi Internet connection share karein. Router ghar ke network ka bunyadi device hai. Network set up karna data share karna asan aur tez banata hai, aur theek configuration us ki raftar aur hifazat behtar karti hai.

items: Router: network ke tamam devices jorta hai.
Modem: ghar ke network ko Internet Service Provider se jorta hai.
Network devices: computers, laptops aur mobile phones.
Wired connections ke liye network cables; wireless devices ke liye Wi-Fi signals.

blocks.caption: Wired aur wireless connections
rows: Ethernet cables, seedhe router ya switch se
Radio signals; gharon mein Wi-Fi sab se aam
Baaz suraton mein wired se sust
Cables ki wajah se devices azadi se hil nahi sakte
Range ke andar azadi se hil sakte; lagana aur chalana asan

blocks.alt: ISP ka badal modem se, aur modem 'default gateway' router se jura jis ke oopar Wi-Fi lehrein. Router se Ethernet cable neeche wired PC tak. Router se dashed Wi-Fi lines laptop aur phone tak. Dashed dabba 'guest network (alag naam)' mein mehmanon ke do phones, sirf Internet. Neeche sabz dabba: router mehfooz karein, admin password badlein, WPA2 ya WPA3 (WEP nahi), mazboot Wi-Fi password, aur mehmanon ko guest network dein.
blocks.caption: Wired, wireless aur guest connections wala ghar ka network (1.9 aur 1.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Modem ghar ko ISP se jorta hai; router woh connection har device ke saath, cable ya Wi-Fi se, share karta aur Internet ka default gateway banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Wired connection ka aik faida aur wireless connection ka aik faida batayein.
blocks.explanation: Wired: zyada raftar, zyada mustehkam aur zyada mehfooz. Wireless: cables nahi, is liye devices range mein azadi se hil sakte, aur lagana asan.

items: Ghar ka network: router (markaz), modem (ISP tak), devices, cables ya Wi-Fi.
Wired: tez, mustehkam, zyada mehfooz; wireless: azad harkat, asan setup.
